name: Nitta Corporation India Pvt Ltd
india_angle: Nitta Corporation India Private Limited is a fully owned subsidiary of Nitta Corporation Japan, established at Pune in 2012, with fabrication facilities located at Pune and Coimbatore.
summary: Nitta Corporation India Pvt Ltd primarily offers industrial products such as flat belts, belt joining tools, and wiper seals. Their products are used in various industries, but there is no specific mention of semiconductor-related applications.
